title: WHATWG HTML Living Standard, “Rendering”
lede: The current specification of how browsers are expected to display unstyled HTML, including link blue and visited purple.
summary: WHATWG Rendering section: the default link colors #0000EE and #551A8B, and h1 at 2em.

evidence.note: Read the Rendering section on 2026-10-02. A living standard changes, so the values are as of that date.

styles.note: Defines the exact default colors and sizes that the style’s tokens copy.

context: The expected style sheet contains `:link { color: #0000EE; }` and `:visited { color: #551A8B; }`.
It sets `:heading(1) { margin-block: 0.67em; font-size: 2.00em; }`, the same h1 size as [CSS 2 Appendix D](ref:css2-default-style-sheet-for-html).
interpretation: The source for the primary and secondary colors in the [Brutalist web design](style:brutalist-web-design) tokens.

rights.statement: WHATWG specification text. No license statement was found on the Rendering page. Link and quotation only; no image stored.
